comment: The NVIDIA SimReady starter set (docs/design/simready-props.md): every file phase 2 may download, pinned by size and hash on 2026-11-08 from the Hugging Face tree API. A file whose live size or hash differs is not fetched. `same_as` marks content already fetched under another asset (NVIDIA shares its tiling material textures), which is copied locally instead. Left out on purpose: the MDL shaders, source_assets/ (copies of the same PNGs beside the MDL files), the solver-specific physics layers (PhysX, Newton, MuJoCo enabled variants, runnables/ and instances_*), and texture previews. Two assets (dishware_mug_a01, dishware_bowl_a01) use the newer NVIDIA layout: a .usda root, no disabled.usda layers (their Disabled variants pull nothing) and no _thumbnail.png, so their look image is the 256 px render. Phase 2 fetches each asset in two passes: metadata, layers and the look image first; then only the textures its materials.usda actually references (this list is the most it may fetch). Licence: every asset here is CC BY 4.0 (docs/reference/findings/2026-11-08-nvidia-simready-assets.md).
